description: A representation with k = 2 and inner dimension 17 on a 14-port subset of P104. Ports are given by index into ports_p104.json. K is an orthogonal 8-set; 'others' are six ports with exactly two odd neighbours in K. coords[t] lists the two coordinates (of 17) that the rows of W_t and U_t occupy: W_t = U_t has rows e_a and e_b for coords[t] = [a, b], so B_ST is the matrix of coordinate overlaps. Coordinates 2i, 2i+1 are the block of the i-th element of K; coordinate 16 is the one extra coordinate.
